important_distinctions: A/Q1 p-values use exact convolution; no inner permutation Monte Carlo. Outer 200 synthetic outcome draws estimate the rejection rate.
A null_low and availability_only have identical marginal law after blocked events are removed. They are independent seeded repetitions, not two different availability mechanisms.

junction_only .1/.6 is constant within each ending family, so it is exchangeable under the exact engine. Additive page/line/position can violate within-stratum exchangeability; it is a robustness stress.

BQ1 original synthetic nulls/positive allow qok on structurally blocked followers. They test an abstract outcome model. The extra availability-only scenario instead induces a nonzero aggregate association and is not a sharp null for unconditioned Q1.
BQ2 has outer simulation uncertainty, finite inner permutation sampling, observed zero variance, and context/folio nonexchangeability issues; more simulations alone do not remove those issues.
